[Emissary Assistance](/Feats.aspx?ID=5287) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 20

</column>

---

As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements. You gain [_feet to fins_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1525) and [_water breathing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1755) as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.
